title: Application Security Assessment and Remediation
description: Run authorized web, API, code, dependency, secret, and configuration assessment through reviewed remediation and verified closure.
setup_prompt: Use Application Security Assessment and Remediation with my authorized scope. Configure the rules of engagement, applicable browser/API/code/supply-chain routes, CI and vulnerability webhooks, Slack collaboration, evidence and severity policy, remediation approval, deployed retesting, and restricted dashboard. Recommend only compatible MCPs, CLIs, and reviewed public skills needed for the selected routes.

setup_inputs.label: Written scope, environments, allowed techniques, exclusions, and stop conditions
Applications, APIs, repositories, services, builds, and owners
Applicable browser, API, code, dependency, secret, and configuration routes
Control, severity, review, remediation SLA, and risk-acceptance policy
Evidence classification, redaction, access, and retention
CI/webhook/Slack, issue, source-control, deployment, and reporting destinations

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks API trigger
recommended_tools.purpose: Start fixed AppSec routes from authenticated CI, SCM, scanner, or vulnerability events

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks managed agent-browser
recommended_tools.purpose: Inspect browser state and collect supported restricted evidence

recommended_tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
recommended_tools.purpose: Read repositories, commits, pull requests, and checks and create authorized remediation work

recommended_tools.name: Semgrep MCP Server
recommended_tools.purpose: Run and interpret Semgrep code, supply-chain, and secret analysis

recommended_tools.name: SonarQube MCP Server
recommended_tools.purpose: Use an existing SonarQube Server or Cloud security-analysis program

recommended_tools.name: Snyk MCP Server
recommended_tools.purpose: Use an existing Snyk program for code, dependency, container, and IaC findings

recommended_tools.name: Semgrep CLI
recommended_tools.purpose: Provide local multi-language static analysis and machine-readable findings

recommended_tools.name: Gitleaks CLI
recommended_tools.purpose: Detect secrets in files and Git history with redacted structured output

recommended_tools.name: OSV-Scanner CLI
recommended_tools.purpose: Match lockfiles and software inventories to OSV vulnerability data

recommended_tools.name: Trivy CLI
recommended_tools.purpose: Scan filesystems, repositories, images, dependencies, secrets, and misconfiguration

recommended_tools.name: OWASP ZAP
recommended_tools.purpose: Run authorized passive baseline and configured dynamic web assessment

recommended_tools.name: Checkov CLI
recommended_tools.purpose: Scan Terraform and other supported infrastructure-as-code for policy violations

recommended_tools.name: Nuclei CLI
recommended_tools.purpose: Run only explicitly selected and authorized template-based security checks

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks Slack bot
recommended_tools.purpose: Support triage, evidence links, fix status, and correlated decisions

recommended_skills.name: Audit Context Building
recommended_skills.purpose: Map unfamiliar code and trust assumptions before vulnerability hunting

recommended_skills.name: Differential Security Review
recommended_skills.purpose: Review security impact and blast radius of commits and pull requests

recommended_skills.name: False-Positive Check
recommended_skills.purpose: Validate candidate findings before promotion to confirmed status

recommended_skills.name: Variant Analysis
recommended_skills.purpose: Search for other instances after one root-cause pattern is confirmed

recommended_skills.name: SARIF Parsing
recommended_skills.purpose: Normalize and inspect structured scanner output

recommended_skills.name: Security Fix Review
recommended_skills.purpose: Review whether a proposed fix addresses the finding without regression

recommended_skills.name: Supply Chain Risk Auditor
recommended_skills.purpose: Assess dependency maintenance and takeover risk when supply-chain review is in scope

pulse_focus.label: Technical review
focus_areas: Finding validity, scope, severity, and remediation verification
review_when: A run fails, produces incomplete evidence, or a key metric becomes unreliable

pulse_focus.label: Architecture review
focus_areas: Assessment boundaries, tool isolation, approval gates, and evidence chain
review_when: The workflow, integration, environment, scale, or operating policy changes materially

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Security investment, residual risk, and release policy
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge

outputs: Complete assessment results and restricted evidence
Reviewed findings with severity and confidence
